grok.performance_metric: ~$3.2bn impairment-driven loss; Chapter 11 then full asset sale for $310M ~24 mo
grok.rationale: The slice documents massive 2018 impairments ($3,205.1M upstream/midstream), a going-concern warning, Chapter 11 filings in 2019, and bankruptcy sales of substantially all upstream and midstream assets for $310M, followed by SEC deregistration in 2020. None of these realized-outcome lines describe product/process misalignment (p4) or operations-versus-organization/culture fracture (p5); the documented trajectory is financial distress and asset liquidation under commodity-price and indebtedness pressure, with no pathway-specific interface disruption recorded.
